notes.title: 🐱Thank You for Joining the Test!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594566/ab1c9daf441d7e68bd3475bb6b871c70d08a7091.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Fellow critter leaders,[/i] [/p][p]The small-scale technical test has officially come to an end![/p][p][/p][p]As a two-person team releasing our first game, we are incredibly grateful for all the valuable feedback and support you’ve provided during the testing period.[/p][p][/p][p]Moving forward, we’ll be dedicating time to optimizing the game. This includes:[/p][list][*][p] Enhancing the visuals to make the game more visually appealing.[/p][/*][*][p] Adjusting the difficulty curve for a smoother gameplay experience.[/p][/*][*][p] Expanding game content to make it even more engaging.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We aim to make the game even more fun and polished! Our plan is to release a free demo version by the end of the year, and we can’t wait to share the improved experience with you.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon! :)[/p][p]Rat2 Studio 🐭[/p]

notes.title: 🐭 Galaxy Critter Co. Playtest Announcement!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594566/1ff471bfe17f9fec117fa5a2dedd46938a70f90e.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Critter Leaders,[/p][p]Nice meeting y'all![/p][p]
We are [b]Rat2 Studio[/b], a 2-person development team🐭. After more than a year of work, our game [b]Galaxy Critter Co.[/b] has finally taken shape 🎉. [/p][p][/p][p]At this point, we plan to launch a [b]small-scale technical test[/b] and hope to collect some feedback from players around the world![/p][p][/p][p][b]⌚Playtest details:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Application Start Date:[/b] You can [i][b]now[/b][/i] apply for the playtest on the store page.[/p][/*][*][p][b]First Approval Date:[/b] Expected on [b]August 15th[/b] (we hope everyone can play by Friday night!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Subsequent Applications:[/b] Applications submitted after August 15th will be approved within [b]1-3 days[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Test End Date:[/b] Around [b]August 31st[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you encounter any [b]bugs[/b] or have any [b]suggestions[/b], please share them with us via the in-game survey or through our official community channels. Your feedback would be incredibly important to a small team like us![/p][p][/p][p][b]🎮About the Playtest Version:[/b]
This is still an [b]early version[/b], and the game’s balancing, art, and other aspects are still a work in progress. 
In future demo, we plan to add:[/p][list][*][p][b]A complete game storyline[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]some more new mechanics[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]More buildings, weapons, items, and maps[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]-- Please just give us a bit more time![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and participation! [/p][p][b]Happy Bug Extermination![/b]🛠️🐞[/p][p]
Rat2 Studio[/p]
